create_masked_language_model: create a MaskedLanguageModel instance from a pretrained model path with a given device and dtype
embed_batch_with_splade_pooling: embed a PaddedBatch of input tokens using the MaskedLanguageModel and SpladePooling to get embeddings
check_model_position_ids_support: check if a masked language model supports position_ids by inspecting the forward method signature
configure_roberta_position_offset: configure the position offset for RoBERTa-family models like xlm-roberta, camembert, or roberta
get_max_input_length: get the maximum input length from a model config using max_seq_length or max_position_embeddings
